content.narrative_significance: This phase's target, no_face_loneliness, was selected by re-evaluating the live two-way tie at 57 (no_face_loneliness, train_memory_scene) under the established tie-break: primary criterion (fewest existing dedicated real chains) left both anchors tied at 28, so the secondary alphabetical tiebreak applied directly: no_face_loneliness < train_memory_scene, so no_face_loneliness was adopted — the same reading PHASE-143 reached the last time this exact pair tied. A registry-confirmed reuse-candidate search performed before this phase's authoring found 76 usable candidates for no_face_loneliness (not zero, so no STOP was required); the lowest, tunnel_threshold_0058, was genuinely fresh (never used as a leg under any anchor) and carries REAL tags for both no_face_loneliness and river_spirit_departure. A payoff search under the PHASE-199 policy found 57 valid candidates before the plant leg was written (not zero, so no STOP was required); because the plant leg consumed the lowest of those 57 (the same fresh scene), the payoff was drawn from the next-lowest remaining candidate, parental_transformation_0059, which carries REAL tags for both no_face_loneliness and train_memory_scene. This chain, named 'twenty_ninth_confirmed' extending the established chain_isolation_* naming discipline, gives no_face_loneliness its twenty-ninth dedicated real chain. FULL cross-anchor payoff-pool accounting (both legs' real tags counted, not just the payoff leg's, per PHASE-235's corrected methodology applied correctly from the start this time): no_face_loneliness itself drops by TWO, not one, because BOTH the plant and payoff scenes carry a real no_face_loneliness tag (57 -> 55); river_spirit_departure drops by one because the plant scene also carries a real river_spirit_departure tag (56 -> 55), a cross-anchor reduction from the PLANT leg; train_memory_scene drops by one because the payoff scene also carries a real train_memory_scene tag (57 -> 56), a cross-anchor reduction from the PAYOFF leg; bathhouse_arrival (56) and bridge_crossing (56) are unaffected — neither leg carries either tag. Full record after this phase: bathhouse_arrival 56, bridge_crossing 56, no_face_loneliness 55 (this phase's target), river_spirit_departure 55, train_memory_scene 56. Next priority by the largest-pool convention: bathhouse_arrival, bridge_crossing, and train_memory_scene, three-way tied at 56. No new payoff rule, contract, or algorithm introduced — the PHASE-199 policy is unchanged. Separately, this phase's Episode-fresh recount (episode-usage domain) found bridge_crossing/no_face_loneliness/train_memory_scene all still exhausted at 0 and bathhouse_arrival's single reserved scene correctly held back; with river_spirit_departure the only remaining usable source for the second consecutive phase, this Episode again draws both of its scenes from a single anchor category rather than two different ones — disclosed here per explicit instruction, not silently treated as business-as-usual.
